The '''guardians''' were incorporeal spirits of residents of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oblis]] who were [[Death/Legends|killed]] when Oblis was [[Destruction of Oblis|destroyed]] by the [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] the [[Darkstaff]] thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In the aftermath of the destruction of Oblis, the Darkstaff came to lie within a chamber on the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[I-9]] in an [[Cularin asteroid belt|asteroid belt]] formed from the remains of Oblis. To prevent the Darkstaff from falling into the wrong hands, the guardians, along with a number of [[Oblee|shadow lurkers]], disembodied Oblee that were also turned into spirits by the destruction of Oblis inhabited the asteroid to stop the Darkstaff from being taken away.<ref name="Recursion" />

In circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]],<ref name="31 BBY">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is placed in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Therefore, ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' can be dated to circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]].</ref><ref name="Philology">{{LivingForce|Below the Belt: Philology}}</ref> the guardians interacted with the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelancers who had venture to I-9 while on a mission, within the asteroid's [[room of six shadows]].<ref name="Recursion" />

The guardians had vaguely shadowy forms that hovered in the air and were wispier in appearance that the disembodied Oblee shadow lurker spirits that inhabited I-9 as well.<ref name="Recursion" />
